name: garmin-owl
description: Local access to Garmin health and training data, with confirmed activity notes.

interface.longDescription: Read your Garmin health and training data through a local stdio MCP server. Its only write tool, commit_activity_note, changes the description of one existing activity after a preview you confirm. Garmin session tokens and the normalized SQLite cache stay on your computer. No network listener, telemetry, remote database, or bundled credentials.
defaultPrompt: How did I sleep last night?
How have my resting HR and HRV changed month by month over the last year?
